**Turn Up and Go and Bookable route online purchases**. If you have purchased tickets online as a group or for any number of travel companions, for use on any of our [Turn Up and Go](https://www.calmac.co.uk/tickets/turn-up-and-go) or [Bookable routes](https://www.calmac.co.uk/faqs/tickets-and-reservations/bookable-routes), the full party must travel on the same sailing. **Connecting Services**  For customers using [connecting services](https://www.calmac.co.uk/on-board/connecting-services) please note these services do not always guarantee a connection, particularly during times of disruption. We advise that you check both CalMac and connecting service websites prior to travel to ensure you can reach your end destination safely.

title: Car parking at Troon
detail:
The owners of Troon port, Associated British Ports, operate the car park at the port. Please be advised that charges apply.

[Read our frequently asked questions on travel to/from Troon](https://www.calmac.co.uk/en-gb/faqs/before-you-travel/arran-service-operating-fromto-troon/)  for further details on car parking and other useful information about what to expect at the port.

title: MV Alfred Retail Service
detail:
There is no hot meals service on onboard MV Alfred. However, there is a cold drinks/snacks vending machine located in the passenger lounge. The vending machine accepts both cash and card.

Refreshments including hot drinks and snacks are available from Troon port. Cash and card payments are accepted.

title: MV Alfred Vehicle Customers
detail:
MV Alfred can accommodate all types of vehicles, with the exception of motorhomes over 6 metres or any vehicle towing a caravan. If you are travelling in a motorhome of any size, please make your booking via our  [Customer Engagement Centre](https://www.calmac.co.uk/en-gb/contact-us/#/)  or port of departure. Any customers with a motorhome over 6 meters must travel on Ardrossan-Brodick or via our Claonaig-Lochranza service.

[View information on travelling via Claonaig-Lochranza.][1]

title: Wednesday 4 November
detail:
MV Caledonian Isles will be removed from service for 1 day on Wednesday 4 November to allow repairs to be carried out on the Port Mezzanine deck.  As a result, service will operate to/from Troon.

MV Alfred's maintenance period will now be carried out in Brodick which will allow the vessel to provide the following additional sailing:
 
**Depart** Brodick - 08:10
 
All other sailings operated by MV Alfred will operate as per published timetable.

Please note MV Alfred will be required to operate a repositioning sailing back to Brodick on Tuesday 3 November, no passengers or vehicles will be carried on this service to allow the vessel to proceed straight onto the concrete berth to begin Maintenance.
